item.title: A spec-compliant OTLP receiver, brought to you by a dead SSD
item.description: Post #2 was supposed to be about writing a spec-compliant OTLP receiver. Then Windows 11 corrupted my entire SSD. It's about both: partial_success, backpressure, and the value of pushing early.

item.title: Rebuilding Junkyard: a mini-Datadog from scratch
